authorship: Literal strings and source/profile decisions only; no new implementation or calculator executed. Existing frozen composition outcomes were read, not regenerated. Full reachable SQL seeds and complete HTTP expected matrices must be frozen separately before implementation tests.

baselineRecipe.requiredFixtureQualification: Recipe, not an executable SQL seed. Seed every actual required saved projection field and source-shaped header/book/configuration/rights row. Do not inject synthetic core state into HTTP. NULL only where the existing projection permits it.

openingBalance.reason: Customer balance requires a resolved ledger mode.

baselineRecipe.additionalAdmission: One exact matching ITEM_MAST with saved/master RATE_TYPE and IT_TYPE equal; configured MAIN_BOOK SALES RETURNE/I/SL_DATA; all relevant widths nonzero; period open; full scope/current View principal; no outgoing/component/BAR/DM rows; separate foreign tenant/book sentinels. Actual raw Float/NUMERIC scales are asserted from schema/storage, not guessed as 0 versus 0.00.
baselineRecipe.syntheticPureDifferences: Unlike original composition fixture, HTTP hydrate leaves c41/c42 blank and row/aggregate journals empty, and initializes canonical formatted bill caches. Do not assert synthetic cache text 110.0000/10.0 or color red as saved HTTP projection output.

http.title: GET and lookup do not commit a code
http.setup: Open baseline, lookup BB for c13 against initial prefix.

http.title: Resolved rate then reversal retains bill history
http.setup: Append observed c13 BB; observe AA against that accepted prefix; append observed c13 AA.

http.title: Same-code selection still invokes callbacks
http.setup: From baseline explicitly observe and append c13 AA twice, preserving both events.

http.title: Tag04 has no value destination but commits
http.setup: From baseline observe and append same c29 TA/category04/value99.

http.title: Copied fixed amount can be overwritten by retained cache
http.setup: Baseline saved labour rate1 seeds cache58=1.00; append c13 C3/category03/value5.

http.title: Money and code events interleave bill callbacks
http.setup: Append c13 BB; append money c27=1; append c13 AA.

http.title: Literal zero and empty-tag fallback are separate facts
http.setup: Separate fixture raw TAG_LBR_CODE blank projects fallback AA; another pure-only fixture has truly blank visible c29. Observe zero-valued category01.

http.title: Candidate missing, aliases and malformed values
http.setup: Lookup missing ZZ; exact BB plus bb; separate one-character code A plus A-space, and separate canonical company Q plus Q-space/q aliases (all within varchar2); category unknown/null; value NULL/nonfinite.

http.title: Observation changes between lookup and append
http.setup: Observe BB then update its value before append with old observationVersion.

http.title: Historical master change blocks a different new lookup
http.setup: Accept BB; change BB physically; attempt lookup AA with the prior BB journal.

http.title: Master physical ABA and recreation
http.setup: After accepted BB, update BB 2→3→2, or delete/reinsert BB with identical raw values.

http.title: Unrelated and absence history limits
http.setup: Change another tenant/company or unrelated code. Separately observe absent code before and after absent→insert→delete.

http.title: All non-labour dependencies remain bound
http.setup: Change header/row physical revision, relevant item master/alias, tax setting/label, configured width or Return book/year.

http.title: Exact input and prefix correspondence
http.setup: Extra raw/category/value/policy/ordinal fields; unsupported kind; money field presented as labour; short/uppercase hash; forged prefix events or missing old event.

http.title: Actual opaque identity and SQL order
http.setup: Seed rows SR17 and42 and a separate scientific-range representable SR case; choose the matching server rowIdentity.

http.title: Candidate downstream rollback equals previous accepted prefix
http.setup: Use a separately frozen reachable saved fixture/admitted category/value that fails after copy in row/fold/bill or editor/output validation. Preserve earlier successful prefix.
source: new contract: do not inject unreachable synthetic state into HTTP

http.title: Empty, outgoing and hidden state containment
http.setup: Read valid empty header; add outgoing/component/issue/tag state; hide c13 or make its width unresolved.

http.title: View rights are fresh inside snapshot
http.setup: View-only/Update-denied principal succeeds; remove View after prehandler before RR admission; require reset on target principal.

http.title: Context epoch and pair are required
http.setup: Old JWT after A→B→A; new bearer with old same-scope page pair; missing or partial pair; forged sid/epoch in body.

http.title: RR lock schedules and default clock
http.setup: Test preview SHARE-first versus selection/refresh/revoke UPDATE-first; lock-wait expiry and final expiry. Observe actual PG waits and settle both tasks.

http.title: One RR master/config/header observation
http.setup: Hold one real query, change master/config/header from a second committed connection, resume all reads.
source: existing withTenant RR and internal Tx readers

http.title: Replay request repeat has one journal append
http.setup: Drop delivery after completed append; retry identical old prefix and candidate while dependencies unchanged.

http.title: Output growth and event bounds preserve recovery
http.setup: 100 old events then append; oversized body; a candidate output exceeding the new explicit result bound.
source: new transport limits, not desktop constraints

http.title: Existing four routes and no-write footprint
http.setup: Run previous v1 row/bill fixtures and new real GET/lookup/append success/refusal with whole-state SQL text/xmin/ctid snapshots.

ui.title: Exclusive owner is synchronous
ui.setup: Open old row/bill preview or make metadata dirty; attempt labour start.

ui.title: Lookup remains separate from commit
ui.setup: Type BB and check code; blur/Tab/change focus; explicitly commit once.

ui.title: Same-code Enter is not deduplicated
ui.setup: Enter an already selected qualified AA twice as two intentional operations.

ui.title: Late lookup cannot replace edited draft
ui.setup: Start BB lookup, change draft to AA before response; release BB response.

ui.title: Lookup is pinned to accepted prefix
ui.setup: Start code lookup then accept another operation or explicitly discard/reopen before response.

ui.title: Late requests cannot update new document or page
ui.setup: Hold real response then close, unmount, switch saved document, switch scope or pause selection.

ui.title: Stale dependency preserves work
ui.setup: Historical master/base changes before lookup or append.

ui.title: Full candidate rollback remains visible
ui.setup: Receive validated422 recovery equal to the old prefix after downstream rejection.

ui.title: Response schema is checked before adoption
Bounded code input preserves full loaded text
ui.setup: Loaded code longer than2 stays fully visible; echo commit refuses; explicit AA replacement succeeds if qualified.
source: current code2 profile versus desktop editorMaxLength4

ui.title: Unknown/hidden code support is explained
ui.setup: Missing ZZ lookup, hidden c13, unresolved width or empty grid.

ui.title: Uncertain read response retries exact history
ui.setup: Lose successful append response; explicit retry exact pending old prefix+event; reject new-session response.
